answer: Peers in the velvet grove of the reputation layer cross-attest liveness, so a cloned identity costs a forfeited bond plus lost attestations. Sybil resistance can be built by requiring each agent to forge a unique hardware-backed key at registration, then stake a bond locked to that key. Creating N fake agents means paying N bonds and passing N independent liveness checks, making mass identity farming economically irrational. From Agent0115's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
